<script lang="ts">
	import { setCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { Props } from "./index.js";
	import type { CompCtxProps } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	let { open = $bindable(false), onOpenChange, direction = "bottom", size = "md", rounded = "lg", children }: Props = $props();
	const baseId = $props.id();
	const contextData: Pick<CompCtxProps, "direction" | "size" | "rounded" | "onOpenChange"> = $derived({ direction, size, rounded, onOpenChange });
	const ctx = setCompCtx({ ...contextData, open, baseId });

	// Keep the shared settings in sync when the props change.
	$effect.pre(() => void Object.assign(ctx, contextData));

	// Keep the bindable prop and the shared open state in sync in both directions.
	$effect.pre(() => void (ctx.open = open));
	$effect.pre(() => void (open = ctx.open));
</script>

<!-- Trigger and content parts; the content renders the modal while open. -->
{@render children()}

<script lang="ts">
	import { Button } from "#lib/components/ui/button/index.js";
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { CloseProps } from "./index.js";
	const { children, trigger, variant = "outline", size, rounded, class: className }: CloseProps = $props();
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
	const closeProps = { onclick: () => ctx.setOpen(false) };
</script>

<!-- Render the custom close trigger when given, otherwise a default button. -->
{#if trigger}
	{@render trigger({ props: closeProps })}
{:else}
	<Button {variant} {size} {rounded} class={className} {...closeProps}>{@render children?.()}</Button>
{/if}

{#if ctx.open}
{#if ctx.direction === "bottom"}
{/if} {@render children()}
{/if}
{@render children()}

<script lang="ts">
	import type { FooterProps } from "./index.js";
	const { children, class: className, ...props }: FooterProps = $props();
</script>

<!-- Actions pinned to the bottom of the drawer. -->
<footer class={["drawerFooter", className]} {...props}>
	{@render children()}
</footer>

<style>
	/* Base footer; pushed to the bottom of the panel */
	.drawerFooter {
		display: flex;
		flex-direction: column;
		gap: var(--spacing-sm);
		margin-top: auto;
		padding: var(--drawer-padding);
	}
</style>

<script lang="ts">
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { HeaderProps } from "./index.js";
	const { children, class: className, ...props }: HeaderProps = $props();
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
</script>

<!-- Title and description; centered in top and bottom drawers on narrow screens. -->
<header class={["drawerHeader", className]} data-direction={ctx.direction} {...props}>
	{@render children()}
</header>

<style>
	/* Base header; the padding comes from the size on the drawer */
	.drawerHeader {
		display: flex;
		flex-direction: column;
		gap: calc(var(--spacing-xs) / 2);
		padding: var(--drawer-padding);
		touch-action: none; /* touch drags start on the header, so the content can still scroll */
	}

	.drawerHeader[data-direction="top"],
	.drawerHeader[data-direction="bottom"] {
		text-align: center;
	}

	/* Aligns to the start once the screen is wide enough */
	@media (min-width: 48rem) {
		.drawerHeader[data-direction="top"],
		.drawerHeader[data-direction="bottom"] {
			text-align: left;
		}
	}
</style>
{@render children()}

<script lang="ts">
	import { Button } from "#lib/components/ui/button/index.js";
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { TriggerProps, TriggerAttrs } from "./index.js";
	const { children, trigger, variant = "outline", size, rounded, class: className }: TriggerProps = $props();
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
	const triggerProps: TriggerAttrs = { "aria-haspopup": "dialog", onclick: () => ctx.setOpen(true) };
</script>

<!-- Render the custom trigger when given, otherwise a default button. -->
{#if trigger}
	{@render trigger({ props: triggerProps })}
{:else}
	<Button {variant} {size} {rounded} class={className} {...triggerProps}>{@render children?.()}</Button>
{/if}
